description: VYBE Music v4.2.0 - YouTube Playlist Import & Refresh Persistence Fix, Real Phone Stream Playback Fix, Listen Together Host/Guest Sync Fix, and Battery Optimization.
changelog: Fixed Disappearing Playlists: Local & imported playlists are now permanently bookmarked and protected from being wiped or hidden on library refresh or account sync
Real Phone Stream Playback: Resolved stream CDN 403 Forbidden issues on mobile networks by using client User-Agent and range fallback
Listen Together Synchronization: When host pauses, stops, or changes songs, guest devices immediately pause instead of continuing to play
Battery Usage Optimization: Disabled background widget loop when no widgets exist, optimized WiFi locks, and reduced position polling frequency
Full YouTube Playlist Import: Imported playlists fetch all pages with zero missing songs and full dynamic mix/radio support
Listening Stats in Library: In place of Recap, library now displays total listening hours and days since the app was installed
